retrievalProfile.description: A centered back-view portrait with high-contrast rim lighting and layered serif typography for dramatic urban storytelling.
triggerTerms: high contrast rim lighting on muscular back

recipe.visualDefinition: A muscular male figure viewed from behind, centered in the frame, featuring prominent back tattoos and a handgun tucked into the waistband. The lighting is high-contrast with strong white rim highlights against a desaturated, cool-toned background. Bold, red serif typography is layered over the center of the back, flanked by smaller white supporting text.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography layered directly over the central subject's back
High-contrast rim lighting defining the silhouette against a bright background
Symmetrical composition centered on the spine
Color contrast between red display text and monochrome imagery
coreInvariants: Back-facing perspective of the primary subject
High-contrast lighting with bright white edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered muscular torso occupying 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red display typography in the center of the back.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the head/shoulders, moves down the spine through the red text, and ends at the weapon in the waistband.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Bright, desaturated space surrounding the dark silhouette of the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated cool grays and blacks for the subject and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for rim lighting and supporting text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark subject and bright background; low saturation except for the red text.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal bars on the 'OR' connector
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scale and color of the same serif family to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Parental advisory style box in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic high-contrast serif look with sharp terminals.
Provides the extreme stroke contrast seen in the display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated photo of a muscular man's back from the waist up, centered. He has intricate black ink tattoos across his shoulders and back. Use strong white rim lighting to separate him from a light gray, vignetted background. A handgun is tucked into the back of his black jeans.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a central stack of text. The main title should be in a bold, red, high-contrast serif font. Flank the middle word with thin horizontal lines. Add smaller white serif text above and below the main title with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the subject centered and facing away?
Is the main text bright red and serif?
Is there high-contrast rim lighting on the subject?
Are the horizontal rules present around the connector word?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the child
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is legible against the dark tattoos.
Ensure the rim lighting creates a clear silhouette.
Verify the text is perfectly centered vertically and horizontally.
Confirm the weapon in the waistband is rendered realistically but subtly.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered back portrait + high-contrast rim light + stacked red serif typography.
